scenario: A plan sponsor's third-party administrator (TPA) uses an agent pipeline to compute the quarterly employer-match contribution for a 401(k) plan. The plan formula is '100% match on the first 3% of eligible compensation, plus 50% match on the next 2% of eligible compensation'. The pipeline ingests participant-level compensation and deferral data from a CSV file, applies the plan's eligible-compensation definition and match formula, and produces a match-contribution report for plan records.
info_flow: afrexai-payroll-audit ingests participant CSV and determines each participant's eligible compensation by applying the plan's pay-type inclusion rules → financial-calculator applies the two-tier match formula to compute each participant's employer match dollar amount → ub2-markdown-report-generator produces the quarterly 401(k) Employer Match Contribution Report.
